Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Project Research Scientist-I (Medical).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in Interview. Candidates do not need to apply online beforehand.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 24 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is an MBBS degree from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 67000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The official notification should be referred to for the exact venue details. However, the recruitment is for AIIMS Jodhpur, Rajasthan.
